title: Determination of Specific Heat Capacity via Aqueous Calorimetry
description: Standard protocol for measuring the specific heat capacity (c) of liquid water using continuous Bunsen burner energy transfer and immersion thermocouple probe.
steps: Measure exactly 150.0 mL of deionized water using the graduated cylinder and transfer to the 250 mL beaker.
Record initial ambient liquid temperature T_initial (target 20.0°C to 25.0°C).
Light the Bunsen burner and adjust to non-luminous blue flame cone.
Place beaker on wire gauze directly above the flame.
Record thermocouple temperature at 5-second intervals until boiling plateau (100.0°C) is reached.
Calculate sensible heat absorbed using Q = m * c * ΔT.
safety: Wear ANSI Z87.1 splash goggles and heat-resistant silicone tongs. Do not heat dry glassware.
